constraints: Stability rests on no alert and on nothing a person or agent does; a failed service is a fault in the system, mended so that kind of failure becomes impossible.

intentStack.statement: Every way a change can still break a workstation service is found and closed.
intentStack.workingMemory: 1 mechanical changes land unjudged. 2 a closure holds TypeScript alone. 3 the overlay's lower layer is the live checkout. 4 running tests mock the work. 5 a crash loop reads as healthy. 6 the watcher dies on one bad page. 7 nothing joins variables read to secrets declared. 8 a unit's command and its tree move apart. 9 restart policy unmatched to exit codes. 10 unit text written verbatim. 11 one of 46 bounds its work's time. 12 a oneshot failing inside its period is unseen.

intentStack.statement: A unit's command and the code that command runs come from one commit.
intentStack.workingMemory: A unit's command takes its path from the live index and runs it out of the tree, so the two halves come from two commits. On 12 Sep a landing wrote all 49 units at 18:02:09, two seconds after the migration moved the runner, while the tree sat at an earlier batch of that same migration. 32 units died for 13h31m, the watcher among them.
